ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated in the central peduncle and lower lobe areas, and 35% high-intensity (off-white/cream) pixels localized on the lateral upper regions of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous cream-colored zones are present on the upper outer quadrants of both lobes. These regions are bordered by high-frequency 'feathered' transitions consisting of dark radial streaks originating from the solid black central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 15% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge is characterized by high-amplitude irregularities; specifically, a deep semi-circular notch is visible on the inner-left lobe trailing edge, and a sequence of sharp, jagged peaks with 5-15 pixel amplitudes spans the length of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curve extending from the median notch to the terminal tips, which taper to acute points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-contrast, raised, circular-to-irregular pixel groups (consistent with barnacle colonization) are visible at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertically-oriented low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) are detectable crossing the high-intensity cream field on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant structural irregularity along the trailing edges, including a large 'missing' chunk or notch on the upper-left lobe and multiple smaller serrated indentations across the right lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Proninent yellowish-brown staining/pigmentation overlaying the white regions of the fluke, particularly visible on the upper-left lobe.
